# ClassDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasClassDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasClassDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasClassDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasClassDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

UML: classes, or a sequence

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasClassDiagram> CreateClassDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasClassDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onClassClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onClassClick` | _Class click_ |
| `onClassDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onClassDoubleClick` | _Class double click_ |
| `onMemberClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&, UMLMemberKind, size_t)> onMemberClick` | (classifierId, compartment, memberIndex) — compartment is UMLMemberKind::Attribute or ::Operation (proposal I4). |
| `onRelationshipClick` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onRelationshipClick` | _Relationship click_ |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onCanvasRightClick` | `std::function<void(double, double)> onCanvasRightClick` | _Canvas right click_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `ClassDiagramTheme`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Default` | neutral grey headers on white |
| `Professional` | muted blue-grey, thin borders |
| `Blueprint` | reference image 1: yellow header band, navy border, graph paper |
| `Colorful` | reference image 4: a different hue per class |
| `DataType` | reference image 5: pale blue «DataType» boxes |
| `Minimal` | no fills, hairline borders |
| `Dark` |  |

### enum `ClassDiagramDetail`

How much of each class is shown (proposal M11).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NameOnly` | header band only |
| `Signatures` | names and types, no parameter lists |
| `Full` | everything |

### enum `ClassDiagramRouting`

How relationship lines are drawn.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Orthogonal` | right angles, obstacle-aware (the UML default) |
| `Straight` |  |

### struct `ClassStereotypeStyle`

A style rule keyed on a stereotype (proposal S4): «interface» boxes orange, «DataType» boxes blue, and so on. The first matching rule wins.
